title: December Faith at Work Luncheon
seo_title: December Faith at Work Luncheon in Joplin, MO
description: The Faith at Work Luncheon is a monthly gathering for prayer, networking, growth, and encouragement, with networking at 11:30 am and a meal and panel from 12:00 to 12:45 pm. It is for local professionals of faith, and lunch is sponsored by Life Choices. It takes place December 1, 2026 (time TBD) at the Crowder College Joplin Advanced Training & Workforce Center, 3405 Hammons Boulevard, Joplin, MO.
venue: Crowder College Joplin Advanced Training & Workforce Center
